description: Manage the world model — rooms, things, exits, and the causal transition ledger of objective-state changes. Mutating actions persist to the Novel and are audited; read-only actions do not mutate state. Revert the most recent mutation with manage_history (action: undo). create_thing honors location_type only when location is set; kind forces property defaults. Use when: creating, updating, removing, or bulk-converting locations and objects, or proposing, admitting, refusing, or reading objective-state transitions (causal_propose/causal_admit/causal_reject/causal_list/causal_state/causal_ingress). Do NOT use when: navigating the world — use run_command (action: execute) or run_command (action: resolve); recording what an entity believes — use manage_belief.

action.description: World: create_room, update_room, remove_room, create_thing, update_thing, remove_thing, create_exit, remove_exit, convert, or generate. Causal: causal_propose, causal_admit, causal_reject, causal_list, causal_state, or causal_ingress.

causal_entity.description: Entity whose objective state is proposed (causal_propose).

causal_scope.description: Scope coordinate (causal_propose; default the active Novel slug).

causal_source_ordinal.description: Contributing event-log ordinal (causal_propose; default the latest event).

key.description: Bound key thing name required to unlock or lock this thing when lockable (create_thing/update_thing).

lit.description: When true the thing is lit (create_thing/update_thing).

lockable.description: When true the thing can be locked (create_thing/update_thing).

locked.description: When true the thing starts locked (create_thing/update_thing).

openable.description: When true the thing can be opened (create_thing/update_thing).

read_text.description: Text revealed when the thing is read (create_thing/update_thing).

readable.description: When true the thing can be read (create_thing/update_thing).

switchable.description: When true the thing can be switched (create_thing/update_thing).

switched_on.description: When true the thing is switched on (create_thing/update_thing).

transparent.description: When true the thing is transparent (create_thing/update_thing).

wearable.description: When true the thing can be worn (create_thing/update_thing).
